complementaryAccents.principle: Brown box with growling bear stays iconic: Bear Brown #3B2316 is ALWAYS primary bg/text/logo-backdrop. Orange is ONLY 8px bar, CTA, protein callout, glow overlay (≤18% opacity or tint ≥30% for soft fills). Green is secondary/evergreen — borders, panels, wasatch dawn — never large enough to outshine brown pack. Use tints for backgrounds/cards, shades for hover/pressed/depth. Test contrast: Bear Brown on Parchment 10.2:1, White on Bear Brown 11:1, Blaze on Parchment 3.1:1 — use Blaze only for large text/CTAs, not body.

usageRules.tintFormula: linear sRGB mix: tint(p) = base*(1-p) + Parchment(#FFF8F0)*p ; p=weight%
usageRules.shadeFormula: linear sRGB mix: shade(p) = base*(1-p) + Ink(#1A1110)*p
iconicBox: Keep pack hero centered, no tint overlays on pack itself — tints only for surrounding UI
Logo reversal only on Bear Brown, Frontier Green, Ink, Black — never on Blaze Orange or tint washes without scrim #1A1110CC
8px Blaze bar is brand signature — use solid #E8530E, not tint, at bottom edge
Warm glows at 12-18% opacity so brown stays dominant in thumbnail
Forest greens desaturated (tint 30-70%) for backgrounds so brown contrast pops

wcagNotes.blazeOnParchment: 3.1:1 — large text/CTA only (needs 3:1 for large, fails 4.5:1 for body)
wcagNotes.recommendation: Body text on Parchment = Bear Brown or Frontier Green; never Blaze Orange for body
